_comment: Canon base founders (plan §10.2). Every skin renders on both. Generate candidates with `node scripts/generate-briefcase-art.mjs bases`, hand-pick one per base, then crown it with `crown --base <novus|nova> --pick <n>`. The crowned render lands in assets-src/briefcase/canon/ and is attached as a reference image to every subsequent skin generation.

novus.name: Novus
novus.description: a teenage-coded young founder character, masc styling: short dark hair with a soft swoop, thick friendly eyebrows, big confident grin with visible teeth, simple oval eyes, warm light-tan toy skin tone
novus.candidateOutfit: plain heather-grey hoodie with a small orange #FF6B00 drawstring detail, dark jeans, white sneakers

nova.name: Nova
nova.description: a teenage-coded young founder character, fem styling: shoulder-length dark hair in a low ponytail with side bang, expressive arched brows, big confident grin, simple oval eyes with small lashes, warm light-tan toy skin tone
nova.candidateOutfit: plain heather-grey hoodie with a small orange #FF6B00 drawstring detail, dark jeans, white sneakers
